I entered upon al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and saw him waiting to break his fast, and I entered upon you and found you in this state and condition." He embraced me and said, "O son of Ashras, do you not know that Allah the Exalted has appointed us to manage the affairs of the Ummah? If we were both to act in the same way, it would leave you no room [for flexibility]. I have broken my fast for those among you who break their fast, and my brother is fasting for those among you who fast." He then said: "The people of truth, whom the people have called upon—and they are the Messengers and the Imams (peace be upon them)—were in one state according to the manner they were intended to be. Sulayman ibn Dawud (peace be upon him), in his kingdom, with all that Allah had subjected to him of jinn, mankind, and birds, was a striver, enduring hardship in the command of Allah and His obedience. Thus, the Exalted said: 'And We gave to Dawud, Sulayman. An excellent servant, indeed he was one who turns back [to Allah].' And He said of Ayyub (peace be upon him) in his illness, his worms, and his struggle: 'Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant, indeed he was one who turns back [to Allah].' Thus, it is fitting for the people of truth to be for their Master in ease and hardship, in difficulty and prosperity, in the state that He is pleased with from them."
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 56

32.ar: أَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَی دَاوُدَ (علیه السلام): أَنَّکَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ لَوْ لَا أَنَّکَ تَأْکُلُ مِنْ بَیْتِ الْمَالِ وَ لَا تَعْمَلُ بِیَدِکَ شَیْئاً. قَالَ: فَبَکَی دَاوُدُ (علیه السلام) أَرْبَعِینَ صَبَاحاً. فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَی الْحَدِیدِ: أَنْ لِنْ لِعَبْدِی دَاوُدَ (علیه السلام). فَأَلَان اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ الْحَدِیدَ فَکَانَ یَعْمَلُ کُلَ یَوْمٍ دِرْعاً فَیَبِیعُهَا بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ فَعَمِلَ ثَلَاثَمِائَةٍ وَ سِتِّینَ دِرْعاً فَبَاعَهَا بِثَلَاثِمِائَةٍ وَ سِتِّینَ أَلْفاً وَ اسْتَغْنَی عَنْ بَیْتِ الْمَالِ.
32.fa: خداوند به داود (علیه السلام) وحی فرستاد: ای داود (علیه السلام)! اگر تو از بیت المال نمی‌خوردی و با دستانت کار می‌کردی، بنده‌ی خوبی بودی! داود (علیه السلام) چهل روز گریست تا خداوند به آهن وحی کرد: برای بنده‌ی من داود (علیه السلام) نرم شو! پس خداوند آهن را برای وی نرم کرد و او در هر روز زره‌ای می‌ساخت و به هزار درهم می‌فروخت. داود (علیه السلام) سیصدوشصت زره ساخت و به سیصدوشصت هزار فروخت و از بیت‌المال بی‌نیاز گشت.
32.en: Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to David (peace be upon him): "You would be an excellent servant, were it not for the fact that you eat from the public treasury (Bayt al-Mal) and do not work with your own hands." David (peace be upon him) wept for forty mornings. Then Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to iron: "Soften for My servant David (peace be upon him)." Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, softened the iron for him, and he would make one suit of armor every day and sell it for a thousand dirhams. He made three hundred and sixty suits of armor, sold them for three hundred and sixty thousand, and became independent of the public treasury.
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 58

32.ar: أَنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام)کَانَ یُحِبُّ الْخَیْلَ وَ یَسْتَعْرِضُهَا فَعُرِضَتْ عَلَیْهِ یَوْماً إِلَی أَنْ غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ فَاتَتْهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ فَاغْتَمَّ مِنْ ذَلِکَ غَمّاً شَدِیداً فَدَعَا اللَّهَ عزّوجلّ أَنْ یَرُدَّ عَلَیْهِ الشَّمْسَ حَتَّی یُصَلِّیَ الْعَصْرَ فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ عَلَیْهِ الشَّمْسَ إِلَی وَقْتِ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّی صَلَّاهَا ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالْخَیْلِ فَأَقْبَلَ یَضْرِبُ أَعْنَاقَهَا وَ سُوقَهَا بِالسَّیْفِ حَتَّی قَتَلَهَا کُلَّهَا وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ اسْمُهُ رُدُّوها عَلَیَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحاً بِالسُّوقِ وَ الْأَعْناقِ.
32.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- حضرت سلیمان (علیه السلام) اسبها را بسیار دوست میداشت و نزد خود می‌طلبید. روزی اسبها را نزدش آوردند و او تا غروب خورشید به آن‌ها سرگرم شد و هنگام نماز عصر او گذشت، سلیمان (علیه السلام) از این امر بسیار غمگین شد و دعا کرد که خداوند عزّ‌وجلّ خورشید را برایش بازگرداند تا نماز عصر را بجای آورد. خداوند سبحان خورشید را به‌هنگام عصر بازگرداند و او نمازش را بجای آورد. آنگاه اسبها را طلبید و با شمشیر شروع به زدن ساقها و گردنهای آن‌ها کرد، تا آنکه همه را کشت و این همان کلام خداوند عزّ‌وجلّ است که فرمود: رُدُّوهَا عَلَیَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَ الْأَعْنَاقِ.
32.en: Solomon (peace be upon him) loved horses and would have them presented to him for inspection. One day, they were presented to him, and he remained occupied with them until the sun set and the time for the afternoon prayer (Asr) had passed. He was deeply grieved by this, so he prayed to Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) to return the sun for him so that he might perform the afternoon prayer. Allah (Glorified is He) returned the sun to the time of the afternoon prayer, and he performed it. Then, he called for the horses and began striking their necks and legs with a sword until he had killed them all. This is the meaning of His (Mighty is His Name) saying: "Bring them back to me," and he began to strike their legs and necks.
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 58
32.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 14, p. 98; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 234; "Wa laqad fatanna... anab" (addition); Al-Burhan; "wa al-a'naq" (omitted).

33.ar: عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ کانَتْ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ کِتاباً مَوْقُوتاً قَالَ مُوجَباً إِنَّمَا یَعْنِی بِذَلِکَ وُجُوبَهَا عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ لَوْ کَانَتْ کَمَا یَقُولُونَ لَهَلَکَ سُلَیْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ (علیه السلام) حِینَ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّی تَوارَتْ بِالْحِجابِ لِأَنَّهُ لَوْ صَلَّاهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِیبَ کَانَ وَقْتاً وَ لَیْسَ صَلَاةٌ أَطْوَلَ وَقْتاً مِنَ الْعَصْرِ.
33.en: Narrated by Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times" (4:103). He said: "It means obligatory. He only intends by that its obligation upon the believers. If it were as they say [i.e., that the time is strictly fixed and cannot be delayed], Solomon son of David (peace be upon him) would have perished when he delayed the prayer until it disappeared behind the veil [of the horizon]. For if he had prayed it before it set, it would have been within its time, and there is no prayer with a longer time [span] than the Asr prayer."
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 58
33.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 340; Mustadrak al-Wasa’il, Vol. 3, p. 108 (with slight variations in wording); Nur al-Thaqalayn and al-Burhan (with variations).

33.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَی مَنْ رُدَّتْ عَلَیْهِ الشَّمْسُ حِینَ تَوارَتْ بِالْحِجابِ.
33.fa: [در زیارت امام علی (علیه السلام) آمده است]: سلام بر آن کسی که وقتی آفتاب در دل تاریکی‌ها رفت، خورشید به خاطر او بازگشت [تا نمازش قضا نشود].
33.en: Peace be upon the one for whom the sun returned when it had veiled itself behind the horizon.
33.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 60

34.ar: قَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی وَ لَنَبْلُوَنَّکُمْ حَتَّی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجاهِدِینَ مِنْکُمْ وَ الصَّابِرِینَ وَ نَبْلُوَا أَخْبارَکُمْ وَ فِی قَوْلِهِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لا یَعْلَمُونَ وَ فِی قَوْلِهِ أَنْ یَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَ هُمْ لا یُفْتَنُونَ وَ فِی قَوْلِهِ وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَیْمانَ وَ فِی قَوْلِهِ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَکَ مِنْ بَعْدِکَ وَ أَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِیُّ وَ قَوْلِ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) إِنْ هِیَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُکَ وَ قَوْلِهِ لِیَبْلُوَکُمْ فِی ما آتاکُمْ وَ قَوْلِهِ ثُمَّ صَرَفَکُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِیَبْتَلِیَکُمْ وَ قَوْلِهِ إِنَّا بَلَوْناهُمْ کَما بَلَوْنا أَصْحابَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ قَوْلِهِ لِیَبْلُوَکُمْ أَیُّکُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَ قَوْلِهِ وَ إِذِ ابْتَلی إِبْراهِیمَ رَبُّهُ بِکَلِماتٍ وَ قَوْلِهِ وَ لَوْ یَشاءُ اللهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَ لکِنْ لِیَبْلُوَا بَعْضَکُمْ بِبَعْضٍ إِنَّ جَمِیعَهَا جَاءَتْ فِی الْقُرْآنِ بِمَعْنَی الِاخْتِبَار.
34.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding the words of the Almighty: "And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you and the patient, and We will test your affairs" (47:31); and regarding His words: "We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know" (7:182); and regarding His words: "Do they think that they will be left to say, 'We believe' and they will not be tried?" (29:2); and regarding His words: "And We certainly tried Solomon" (38:34); and regarding His words: "Indeed, We have tried your people after you, and the Samiri has led them astray" (20:85); and the words of Moses (peace be upon him): "It is not but Your trial" (7:155); and His words: "That He may test you in what He has given you" (6:165); and His words: "Then He turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you" (3:152); and His words: "Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden" (68:17); and His words: "That He might test you as to which of you is best in deed" (11:7); and His words: "And when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands" (2:124); and His words: "And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others" (47:4). He said: "All of these have come in the Quran with the meaning of testing (ikhtibar)."
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 60
34.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 24; al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 2, p. 453

34.ar: فَأَمَّا شَوَاهِدُ الْقُرْآنِ عَلَی الِاخْتِبَارِ وَ الْبَلْوَی بِالاسْتِطَاعَةِ الَّتِی تَجْمَعُ الْقَوْلَ بَیْنَ الْقَوْلَیْنِ فَکَثِیرَةٌ وَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ: لَنَبْلُوَنَّکُمْ حَتَّی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجاهِدِینَ مِنْکُمْ وَ الصَّابِرِینَ وَ نَبْلُوَا أَخْبارَکُمْ وَ قَالَ: سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لا یَعْلَمُونَ وَ قَالَ: الم. أَ حَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَنْ یُتْرَکُوا أَنْ یَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَ هُمْ لا یُفْتَنُونَ وَ قَالَ: فِی الْفِتَنِ الَّتِی مَعْنَاهَا الِاخْتِبَارُ: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَیْمانَ الْآیَةَ وَ قَالَ فِی قِصَّةِ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَکَ مِنْ بَعْدِکَ وَ أَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِیُ وَ قَوْلُ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) إِنْ هِیَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُکَ أَیْ اخْتِبَارُکَ فَهَذِهِ الْآیَاتُ یُقَاسُ بَعْضُهَا بِبَعْضٍ وَ یَشْهَدُ بَعْضُهَا لِبَعْضِ وَ أَمَّا آیَاتُ الْبَلْوَی بِمَعْنَی الِاخْتِبَارِ قَوْلُهُ: لِیَبْلُوَکُمْ فِی ما آتاکُمْ وَ قَوْلُهُ: ثُمَّ صَرَفَکُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِیَبْتَلِیَکُمْ وَ قَوْلُهُ: إِنَّا بَلَوْناهُمْ کَما بَلَوْنا أَصْحابَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ قَوْلُهُ: خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَ الْحَیاةَ لِیَبْلُوَکُمْ أَیُّکُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَ قَوْلُهُ: وَ إِذِ ابْتَلی إِبْراهِیمَ رَبُّهُ بِکَلِماتٍ وَ قَوْلُهُ: وَ لَوْ یَشاءُ اللهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَ لکِنْ لِیَبْلُوَا بَعْضَکُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَ کُلُّ مَا فِی الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ بَلْوَی هَذِهِ الْآیَاتِ الَّتِی شَرَحَ أَوَّلَهَا فَهِیَ اخْتِبَارٌ وَ أَمْثَالُهَا فِی الْقُرْآنِ کَثِیرَةٌ فَهِیَ إِثْبَاتُ الِاخْتِبَارِ وَ الْبَلْوَی إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ وَ عَزَّ لَمْ یَخْلُقِ الْخَلْقَ عَبَثاً وَ لَا أَهْمَلَهُمْ سُدًی وَ لَا أَظْهَرَ حِکْمَتَهُ لَعِبا.
34.en:
As for the Quranic evidence regarding the test and trial through [human] capacity—which synthesizes the two [extreme] positions [of absolute predestination and absolute delegation of power]—it is abundant. Among these is His saying: "And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you and the patient, and We will test your affairs" (Muhammad: 31). And His saying: "We will gradually lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know" (al-A’raf: 182). And His saying: "Alif, Lam, Mim. Do the people think that they will be left to say, 'We believe' and they will not be tried?" (al-Ankabut: 2). And regarding 'fitna' (trial), which carries the meaning of testing, He said: "And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned [to Allah]" (Sad: 34). And in the story of Moses (peace be upon him), He said: "Indeed, We have tried your people after you, and the Samiri has led them astray" (Ta-Ha: 85). And the words of Moses (peace be upon him): "It is not but Your trial" (al-A’raf: 155), meaning: Your test. These verses are to be measured against one another, and they bear witness to one another.

As for the verses where the word 'balwa' (trial) is used in the sense of testing, they include His saying: "That He may test you in what He has given you" (al-An’am: 165). And His saying: "Then He turned you back from them that He might test you" (Al-Imran: 152). And His saying: "Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden" (al-Qalam: 17). And His saying: "[He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed" (al-Mulk: 2). And His saying: "And when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands" (al-Baqarah: 124). And His saying: "And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others" (Muhammad: 4). Every instance in the Quran using the word 'balwa' follows the explanation provided at the beginning, all of which signify testing. There are many such examples in the Quran, and they all serve to establish the reality of testing and trial. The truth is that Allah, the Majestic and Exalted, did not create the creation in vain, nor did He leave them neglected, nor did He make His wisdom a matter of play.
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 60

34.ar: وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَیْمانَ وَ أَلْقَیْنا عَلی کُرْسِیِّهِ جَسَداً ثُمَّ أَنابَ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ إِنَّکَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ وَ هُوَ أَنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ بِالْیَمَانِیَّةِ وُلِدَ مِنْهَا ابْنٌ وَ کَانَ یُحِبُّهُ فَنَزَلَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ عَلَی سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) وَ کَانَ کَثِیراً مَا یَنْزِلُ عَلَیْهِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَی ابْنِهِ نَظَراً حَدِیداً فَفَزِعَ سُلَیْمَانُ (علیه السلام) مِنْ ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ لِأُمِّهِ إِنَّ مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ نَظَرَ إِلَی ابْنِی نَظْرَةً أَظُنُّهُ قَدْ أُمِرَ بِقَبْضِ رُوحِهِ فَقَالَ لِلْجِنِّ وَ الشَّیَاطِینِ هَلْ لَکُمْ حِیلَةٌ فِی أَنْ تُفِرُّوهُ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَقَالَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنَا أَضَعُهُ تَحْتَ عَیْنِ الشَّمْسِ فِی الْمَشْرِقِ فَقَالَ سُلَیْمَانُ (علیه السلام) إِنَّ مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ یُخْرِجُ مَا بَیْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ فَقَالَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنَا أَضَعُهُ فِی الْأَرَضِینَ السَّابِعَةِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ یَبْلُغُ ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ آخَرُ أَنَا أَضَعُهُ فِی السَّحَابِ وَ الْهَوَاءِ فَرَفَعَهُ وَ وَضَعَهُ فِی السَّحَابِ فَجَاءَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ فَقَبَضَ رُوحَهُ فِی السَّحَابِ فَوَقَعَ مَیِّتاً عَلَی کُرْسِیِّ سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) فَعَلِمَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَخْطَأَ فَحَکَی اللَّهُ ذَلِکَ فِی قَوْلِهِ وَ أَلْقَیْنا عَلی کُرْسِیِّهِ جَسَداً ثُمَّ أَنابَ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِی وَ هَبْ لِی مُلْکاً لا یَنْبَغِی لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِی إِنَّکَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ فَسَخَّرْنا لَهُ الرِّیحَ تَجْرِی بِأَمْرِهِ رُخاءً حَیْثُ أَصاب وَ الرُّخَاءُ اللَّیِّنَةُ وَ الشَّیاطِینَ کُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَ غَوَّاصٍ أَیْ فِی الْبَحْرِ وَ آخَرِینَ مُقَرَّنِینَ فِی الْأَصْفادِ یَعْنِی مُقَیَّدِینَ قَدْ شُدَّ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَی بَعْضٍ وَ هُمُ الَّذِینَ عَصَوْا سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) حِینَ سَلَبَهُ اللَّهُ عزّوجلّ مُلْکَه.
34.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- وَ لَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سلیمان وَ أَلْقَیْنا عَلی کُرْسِیِّهِ جَسَداً ثُمَّ أَنابَ تا آنجا که فرمود إِنَّکَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ [قضیّه این بود]، چون حضرت سلیمان (علیه السلام) با زنی یمنی وصلت کرد، پسری از آن زن زاده شد که سلیمان (علیه السلام) او را بسیار دوست میداشت. روزی فرشته‌ی مرگ - که بسیار بر سلیمان (علیه السلام) نازل میشد - نزد وی آمد و نگاه تندی به آن پسر انداخت. سلیمان (علیه السلام) از نگاه او در هراس افتاد و به همسرش گفت: «فرشته‌ی مرگ چنان به پسرم نگریست که گمان میکنم فرمان گرفته تا جان او را بستاند». سپس به جنها و شیطانها فرمود: «آیا راه چارهای در نظر دارید تا این پسر را از مرگ بگریزانید»؟ یکی از آن‌ها عرض کرد: «من او را به زیر چشمه خورشید در شرق میگذارم». سلیمان (علیه السلام) فرمود: «فرشته‌ی مرگ هرآنچه را بین شرق و غرب باشد، بیرون میآورد». دیگری عرض کرد: «من او را در زمین هفتم میگذارم». سلیمان (علیه السلام) فرمود: «فرشته‌ی مرگ به آنجا نیز راه مییابد». دیگری عرض کرد: «من او را در میان ابرها و هوا میگذارم». سپس او را بالا برد و بر ابرها گذاشت. ناگاه فرشته‌ی مرگ آمد و میان ابرها جان آن پسر را گرفت و پیکر بیجانش را بر تخت سلیمان (علیه السلام) گذاشت و آنگاه سلیمان (علیه السلام) دانست که خطا کرده است. خداوند این قصّه را حکایت کرد و فرمود: «وَ أَلْقَیْنَا عَلَی کُرْسِیِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ، قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِی وَهَبْ لِی مُلْکًا لَّا یَنبَغِی لِأَحَدٍ مِّنْ بَعْدِی إِنَّکَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ، فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّیحَ تَجْرِی بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَیْثُ أَصَابَ؛ رخاء یعنی به نرمی، وَ الشَّیَاطِینَ کُلَّ بَنَّاء وَ غَوَّاصٍ؛ یعنی در دریا. وَ آخَرِینَ مُقَرَّنِینَ فِی الْأَصْفَادِ و آن‌ها همان شیطانهایی بودند که وقتی خداوند عزّ‌وجلّ پادشاهی را از سلیمان (علیه السلام) گرفت، از وی نافرمانی کردند.
34.en: "And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned [to Allah]," up to His saying, "Indeed, You are the Bestower." The story is that when Solomon (peace be upon him) married a woman from Yemen, a son was born to him whom he loved dearly. The Angel of Death—who used to descend upon Solomon (peace be upon him) frequently—came to him and cast a sharp gaze upon his son. Solomon (peace be upon him) became alarmed by this and said to the boy's mother, "The Angel of Death looked at my son in a way that makes me think he has been commanded to take his soul." He then asked the jinn and the devils, "Do you have any trick to save him from death?" One of them said, "I will place him under the eye of the sun in the East." Solomon (peace be upon him) replied, "The Angel of Death reaches everything between the East and the West." Another said, "I will place him in the seventh earth." He replied, "The Angel of Death reaches that as well." Another said, "I will place him in the clouds and the air." So he took him up and placed him in the clouds. Then the Angel of Death came and took his soul while he was in the clouds, and his lifeless body fell onto the throne of Solomon (peace be upon him). Solomon (peace be upon him) then realized that he had erred. Allah recounted this in His saying: "And We placed on his throne a body; then he returned [to Allah]," and he said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower." [Then Allah said], "So We subjected to him the wind, blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed." "Rukha'" means gently. "And [also] the devils [of] every builder and diver"—meaning in the sea—"and others bound together in shackles," meaning they were chained, tied one to another; these were the ones who disobeyed Solomon (peace be upon him) when Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) took away his kingdom.
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 62
34.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 14, p. 98; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 234

34.ar: فِی تَفْسِیرِ مَجْمَعِ الْبَیَانِ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام): أَنَّهُ لَمَّا وُلِدَ لِسُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) ابْنٌ قَالَ بَعْضُ الْجِنِّ وَ الشَّیَاطِینِ: إِنْ عَاشَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ لَنَلْقَیَنَّ مِنْهُ مَا لَقِینَا مِنْ أَبِیهِ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ، فَأَشْفَقَ سُلَیْمَانُ مِنْهُمْ عَلَیْهِ فَاسْتَرْضَعَهُ فِی الْمُزْنِ فَلَمْ یُشْعِرْ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ وُضِعَ عَلَی کُرْسِیِّهِ مَیِّتاً تَنْبِیهاً عَلَی أَنَّ الْحَذَرَ لَا یَنْفَعُ عَنِ الْقَدَرِ فَإِنَّمَا عُوتِبَ عَلَی خَوْفِهِ مِنَ الشَّیَاطِین.
34.fa: در تفسیر مجمع البیان از امام صادق (علیه السلام) نقل شده است: هنگامی‌که برای سلیمان (علیه السلام) پسری زاده شد، جنها و شیطانها به یکدیگر گفتند: «اگر پسر او زنده بماند، آزاری که از پدرش دیدهایم از او نیز خواهیم دید». سلیمان (علیه السلام) ترسید که مبادا آن‌ها آسیبی به فرزندش برسانند، ازاین‌رو او را در میان ابرها گذاشت تا آنجا شیر بخورد. ناگهان دید پسرش جان باخته و بر روی تختش افتاده است. او این‌گونه تنبیه شد تا بداند هوشیاری در دفع تقدیر سودمند نخواهد بود و چون از شیطانها ترسید، مجازات شد.
34.en: In the Tafsir Majma' al-Bayan, it is narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him): When a son was born to Sulayman (peace be upon him), some of the jinn and devils said, "If a son of his survives, we shall surely suffer from him what we suffered from his father in terms of affliction." Sulayman (peace be upon him) feared for the child's safety from them, so he had him nursed in the clouds. Suddenly, he realized that the child had been placed upon his throne dead, as a reminder that caution is of no avail against destiny. He was rebuked only because of his fear of the devils.
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 62
34.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 236; Nur al-Thaqalayn; "with slight differences in wording"

34.ar: إِنَّ سُلَیْمَانَ (علیه السلام) قَالَ یَوْماً فِی مَجْلِسِهِ: لَأَطُوفَنَّ اللَّیْلَةَ عَلَی سَبْعِینَ امْرَأَةً تَلِدُ کُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ غُلَاماً یَضْرِبُ بِالسَّیْفِ فِی سَبِیلِ اللَّهِ. وَ لَمْ یَقُلْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَطَافَ عَلَیْهِنَّ فَلَمْ تَحْمِلْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلَّا امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ جَاءَتْ بِشِقِّ وَلَدٍ وَ الْجَسَدُ الَّذِی أُلْقِیَ عَلَی کُرْسِیِّهِ کَانَ هَذَا، قَالَ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَوَالَّذِی نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِیَدِهِ لَوْ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَاهَدُوا فِی سَبِیلِ اللَّهِ فُرْسَاناً.
34.fa: روزی سلیمان (علیه السلام) در تخت خود نشسته بود و فرمود: «امشب با هفتاد زن گِرد خواهم آمد و هریک از آن‌ها پسری میزاید که در راه خدا شمشیر به‌دست می‌گیرد». این را گفت، امّا نگفت: «ان‌شاءالله». او با زنان گرد آمد، ولی تنها یکی از آن‌ها باردار شد که او هم پسری ناقص زایید؛ [و جسدی که بر تختش افتاد همین بود] سپس رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «سوگند به آنکه جان محمّد در دست اوست! اگر گفته بود: ان‌شاءالله، آن پسران، سوار بر اسب در راه خدا جهاد میکردند».
34.en: Solomon (peace be upon him) said one day in his assembly: "Tonight I will go around to seventy wives, and each woman will give birth to a boy who will strike with the sword in the way of Allah." He did not say, "If Allah wills." He went around to them, but none of them conceived except for one woman, who brought forth half a child. The body that was cast upon his throne was this. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "By Him in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), had he said 'If Allah wills,' they would have fought in the way of Allah as horsemen."
34.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 64
